overview.name: YieldMax Memory and Storage Portfolio Option Income ETF
overview.description: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the value of its assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in the equity securities of memory and storage device companies, in memory and storage device ETFs, and in options contracts on memory and storage device companies and on memory and storage device ETFs. It is non-diversified.
